blocks.text: Manchester City silenced a hostile Liverpool crowd in their first match since being found guilty of breaching Premier League financial regulations but there is a deep sense of uncertainty over what it actually means. Enzo Maresca’s men are top of the table with six wins out of six after their impressive 3-0 win at Anfield on Sunday. Yet those points could count for nothing unless City are successful in their appeal against the findings of an independent commission that found them guilty of more than 100 breaches of Premier League rules.
